title: Recommendation Lifecycle Analytics — Board G
purpose: Measure recommendation lifecycle states (Open, Assigned, In Progress, Closed) using actual operational data. Quantify the remediation pipeline backlog.

recommendation_pool_inventory.note: Total QIDs linked (2,105) exceeds pool size because items may appear in multiple recommendations (e.g., a single item with both DL-008 and DL-026). The actual distinct items requiring remediation is approximately 2,382 (242 BLOCKED + 77 REMEDIATE + 154 leakage items + 190 DL-026 resolved = partial net after deduplication).

lifecycle_stage_descriptions.Open: Recommendation generated by scan. Not yet assigned or scheduled. All 4 REC-IDs at this stage.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.Assigned: Recommendation assigned to a session or agent. Specific ownership established.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.In_Progress: Remediation work active. Pack file writes in progress.
lifecycle_stage_descriptions.Closed: Remediation complete. All affected QIDs verified remediated.

recommendations_by_lifecycle_state.analysis: All 4 recommendations are in Open state — none have been assigned, initiated, or completed. This reflects the current operational phase: Framework v2 is in Hybrid Mode (measurement/advisory), not yet in Active Remediation Mode. The recommendations exist as scoped work items but remediation awaits the S811 v2 certification wave.

remediation_pipeline_health.stagnation_risk: HIGH — All 4 recommendations have been in Open state since S206 generation (2026-07-27). No assignment action has occurred. If the recommendations remain Open past S811, the remediation backlog will accumulate with each subsequent certification wave.
remediation_pipeline_health.critical_path: REC-61966733 (DL-008 CRITICAL, 3 QIDs) → REC-5B1E489D (DL-026 HIGH, 274 QIDs) → REC-D3660912 (DL-013 MEDIUM, 31 QIDs) → REC-1100DF07 (EV3 LOW, 2,074 QIDs). Critical path items are the smallest (3 QIDs) but highest severity — they should be assigned and closed first to establish remediation pipeline velocity.
remediation_pipeline_health.batch_constraint: Governance-guard Rule 5 limits writes to ≤30 items per change-set. REC-5B1E489D (274 QIDs) would require ~10 batches. REC-1100DF07 (2,074 QIDs) would require ~70 batches — reinforcing the low priority.
remediation_pipeline_health.estimated_total_batches: REC-61966733: 1 batch. REC-5B1E489D: 10 batches. REC-D3660912: 2 batches. REC-1100DF07: 70 batches. Total: ~83 batches across all recommendations.

recommendation_closure_velocity.assessment: NO_VELOCITY — zero recommendations have been assigned or closed. This is expected for a measurement session — recommendations were generated by S206 and S352 measures them. Assignment and closure occur in subsequent remediation sessions (S811+).

verdict: RECOMMENDATION_PIPELINE_OPERATIONAL — 4 REC-IDs generated, 2,105 QIDs linked, all 4 lifecycle stages defined. However, pipeline velocity is zero: 0 assigned, 0 in progress, 0 closed. All 4 recommendations await assignment (target: S811). The recommendation infrastructure is operational; the first remediation execution will validate the end-to-end Recommendation→Assignment→Progress→Closure lifecycle.
